items.rationale: Pairs needed are 8 x 20 = 160. Take away 70 on hand and 30 on order: 160 - 70 - 30 = 60.
6 x 15 = 90, and 90 - 100 = -10. MAX(0,-10) returns the larger value, which is 0, so there is nothing to reorder.

When stock plus on-order stock is above the need, the sum is negative. MAX(0, ...) returns the bigger of 0 and the shortfall, so the order is never below zero. It does not round or change the size of a positive order.
Pairs on order will join the stock when they arrive, so they count towards the target cover. Leaving them out would double-order and inflate stock.
